text: Implemented dispatch-once logical copy kernels for all seven dtypes with bulk contiguous copy, direct rank-1/rank-2 loops, unrolled 8x8 transpose tiling, and a general-rank counter fallback; routed NDArray.copy and MutableNDArray.freezeCopy. Full core suites pass on JVM (78) and Scala.js (80), optimized JS and JVM bytecode show direct typed access without per-element callbacks/boxing. Two-fork JDK22 speedups: inner stride 33.00x/28.65x and transpose 23.96x/12.71x at sides 256/1024; NumPy ratios 0.848x/1.323x/1.393x/2.420x. Allocation overhead is 784-1210 B/op, within the output+2048 budget. Evidence: modules/benchmarks/results/2026-07-27-local-jdk22-copy/.
